resources.string: Apps\' own shortcuts, the ones their icon shows on a long press (\"New message\", \"Scan QR code\"), are results you can open straight away.
Pressing Back in Niagara\'s search before opening anything takes you back to the app you opened it from, instead of Niagara\'s home screen.

Niagara\'s search ranks and opens results itself, so the settings below that change results apply to the built-in quick launcher. Your keyboard layout, and Back returning to your app, apply to Niagara too.
